main.description: A review of a route: a 1-5 rating, optional text, and optional photos. Activity-neutral. The AppView treats the most recent review per (author, subject) as canonical.

completedAt.description: When the reviewer last did the route (rode, ran, hiked), if they want to say.

labels.description: Self-label values for this review, e.g. to flag sensitive photos.

langs.description: Languages of this record's text (review text, image alt text), as BCP-47 tags. If absent, consumers should assume English ('en').

subject.description: Strong reference to an attrails record, often an app.attrails.route record.

text.description: Review text, as CommonMark markdown. Clients must not render raw HTML.
